stubs.name: MOVE_REAL_ARREAL
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION MOVE_REAL_ARREAL
VAR_INPUT
    IN : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    OUT : ARRAY[0..99] OF REAL;
END_VAR
VAR
    i : DINT;
END_VAR
FOR i := 0 TO 99 DO
    OUT[i] := IN;
END_FOR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Schneider procedure (Unity/Control Expert Arrays library). It copies the REAL value IN into every element of the output array. The vendor version accepts any REAL array, but here the array is fixed to [0..99] to match the call sites.

stubs.name: ROL_ARREAL
stubs.note: Schneider procedure that rotates a REAL array left by N positions, in place. INOUT is declared as an in/out parameter because the array is changed in place. The array size is fixed to [0..99] to match the call sites. The vendor version returns no value, so there is no BOOL result.
